title: Towards More Equitable Question Answering Systems: How Much More Data Do You Need?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Question Answering (QA) performance (F1 scores) across a typologically diverse set of languages (from the TyDi QA dataset) and measuring equitability by calculating the standard deviation of accuracy across languages, the performance gap between the best and worst performing languages, and a population-weighted macro-average.
